notablePrerequisites: Creatures you control (including legendary creatures) can tap to produce at least {3}{R}{R}.
description:
Activate any number of creatures by tapping them, adding at least {3}{R}{R}.
Activate Aggravated Assault by paying {3}{R}{R}, causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat and main phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

uses.name: Esika, God of the Tree // The Prismatic Bridge
